title: Build a local exchange/replay simulator

objectives.text: Compose own pure admission and static matching into a bounded command-log simulation with coherent cash/position/book updates, explicit IOC-like remainder and no outside effects.
Verify full replay determinism, prefix accounting, gate behavior, malformed-log no-result and recovery oracle tests while separating simulated reproducibility from file-crash/live-exchange readiness.

blocks.markdown: Build one coherent toy before adding venue complexity. This full block includes the prior admission and matcher definitions, so no hidden files or network service are needed. Initial cash 1000, position 0, cap 5, asks 3 at 100 then 4 at 101, enabled True; one currency/instrument, zero fees. At most 16 commands, contiguous sequence 1..N. BUY fields are limit and quantity;OFF/ON require zero payload and only change new-BUY admission. These are simulated commands, not venue execution events. No live accounts, real-money actions or professional qualification is implied.

Validate the entire command log before processing any candidate. Each BUY first reserves its FULL requested limit notional/potential quantity against current cash and cap, even if only a partial IOC-like match might be available. This deliberately conservative policy can reject a request whose partial fill would fit. All earlier accepted simulated IOC remainders expire synchronously, so there are no outstanding incoming reservations between commands. If admitted, match the fixed current asks, debit actual passive-price cost, add actual acquired quantity and keep updated asks together in one private state. No persistent/concurrent publication happens.

steps.text: BUY 2 limit 100 takes 2 from ask 1; cash 800, position 2, ask 1 remaining 1, ask 2 remaining 4. OFF then blocks BUY 1 at 101 without changing cash, position or asks.
ON reenables admission. BUY 3 limit 101 fits cap 2+3=5 and requested reservation 303<=800. It takes 1 at 100 plus 2 at 101, cost 302; cash 498, position 5, only ask 2 remaining 2.

Total executed 5; cash spent 502; initial resting 7=executed 5+remaining 2. Rerunning the exact log from the same fixed initial state produces the same result without repeating any real external action.

blocks.caption: Expected first tuple: (498, 5, ((2, 101, 1, 2),), True). Outcomes: seq 1 matched ask 1 qty 2/cost 200; seq 2 OFF; seq 3 disabled; seq 4 ON; seq 5 matched ask 1 qty 1+ask 2 qty 2/cost 302. Then True; invalid command sequence or kind. Complete bounded pure Python 3.12 source embeds own helpers and validates all commands before returning. App support for this pure source remains to be checked in actual runner; no SQLite/files/network are used.

blocks.markdown: Check every valid prefix: 0<=position<=5, cash>=0, position+remaining asks=7. Let r1,r2 be remaining quantities at the two original asks, using 0 if absent. Then position=(3-r1)+(4-r2),cash=1000-100*(3-r1)-101*(4-r2). Retained rows must keep original ID, price and arrival with quantities within original bounds. These equations independently reconcile matching with the account. Disabled BUYs change neither book nor account. A BUY can be matched with zero fills when its limit misses every ask; unfilled is not newly owned quantity.

The implementation reconstructs by full replay from the fixed initial state, not by loading a supplied checkpoint. For each cut, save the observed prefix state for a TEST oracle and verify continuing an independent step reference through the suffix equals full replay. Exact repeat of the entire same log reconstructs the same state; it is not command-level duplicate suppression in a running instance. A duplicate/skipped/out-of-order command sequence is rejected, not silently ignored. Test malformed final command after valid earlier commands; there must be no returned partial candidate and input tuples/list remain unchanged.

Connect this reducer to a real local file-backed journal only after specifying event schema/config version, source identity, transactional command/outcome/applied-cursor boundary and recovery to one coherent target. Persisted command intent does not by itself prove matched real fills. A process crash during file commit requires separate supported transaction/reopen evidence; in-memory replay or exception injection is not that test. Never replay simulated history through a live-send path. Keep source/config artifacts needed to explain decisions; changing initial book, cap, fees or matching policy changes results and requires new versioned fixtures.

Independent transfer: enumerate short logs of BUY/OFF/ON, compare every prefix with a separate unit-consumption reference and apply the independent cash/book equations. Cover exact cap, over-cap, full requested cash rejection, no-match, partial liquidity, disable/reenable, empty log, 16 commands and malformed 17th. Then propose an incremental checkpoint loader and crash-safe file store as separate work, with corrupted/foreign/mixed-cut checkpoints rejected or held. This teaching capstone does not implement a full two-sided exchange, resting incoming orders, asynchronous cancel races, corrections, fees, margin, live feed/session recovery or durable exactly-once effects.

Model composition follows the earlier source-grounded risk and matching contracts; source references here cover [SQLite transaction boundary](https://www.sqlite.org/lang_transaction.html), [atomic-commit limitations](https://www.sqlite.org/atomiccommit.html), and [event-version/replay/concurrency tradeoffs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/architecture/patterns/event-sourcing). The exact initial book, cap, command grammar and synchronous IOC-like path are own educational design. They are not a real exchange specification.

summary: A finite pure simulation can connect admission, matching and exact cash/book accounting with deterministic replay and independent prefix tests. That is not a live venue, a persisted incremental checkpoint loader or file/power-loss recovery certification.
